findings.body: The `OAuthFlow` struct now stores the pending authorizations as `Arc<dyn PendingAuthorizationStore>`. If the `PendingAuthorizationStore` trait is not constrained to `Send + Sync`, the resulting `OAuthFlow` type may not implement `Send` or `Sync`. Code that previously moved an `OAuthFlow` into async tasks or shared it across threads (possible because the earlier `Mutex<HashMap>` was thread‑safe) will now fail to compile or could lead to undefined behavior if forced. Add `+ Send + Sync` bounds to the trait object (e.g., `Arc<dyn PendingAuthorizationStore + Send + Sync>`) or require the trait itself to be `Send + Sync`.
findings.title: Require Send+Sync on pending store trait object

value.summary: The change introduces a thread‑safety regression: the pending store is held as an unsized `Arc<dyn PendingAuthorizationStore>` without `Send + Sync` bounds, which can make `OAuthFlow` non‑Send/Sync and break existing concurrent usage.
